components.name: Button
components.summary: Action trigger in five variants and three sizes, with loading and disabled states.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Status chip with semantic tints and an optional dot.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Round headshot or monogram identity slot, small on cards and large in bio modals.

components.name: Brand lockup
components.summary: Placed master logo with automatic dark-mode swap, and the two-tone product wordmark.

components.name: Container
components.summary: The shared centered content column every app aligns to.

components.name: Grid & Row
components.summary: Token-gapped grid, and a wrapping flex line for button groups.

components.name: Surface & text utilities
components.summary: Surface ground and secondary-text helpers that stay correct in dark mode.

components.name: App shell
components.summary: Full-bleed header and nav whose content aligns to the shared 1200px column.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Bordered surface; interactive cards lift on hover and take a stretched-link trigger.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Data-dense table with tinted header and right-aligned tabular numerals.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: Month view composed from the table component; the highlighted day is the single accent.

components.name: Stats
components.summary: KPI cells that reflow instead of colliding, the canonical stat layout.

components.name: Bullets
components.summary: Hanging-indent list, wrapped text aligns under the text, never the marker.

components.name: Leaders
components.summary: Clickable people cards with round avatar, name, and role.

components.name: Logo wall
components.summary: Client and scheme proof walls, full-colour marks on white tiles, no hover.

components.name: Collapse & Disclosure
components.summary: Progressive disclosure behind a click toggle; native details works with JS off.

components.name: Timeline
classes: ordered list on a token spine
components.summary: Event feed on a border spine; dots take judgement colours only where a judgement exists.

components.name: Value chain
components.summary: Labelled steps joined by › arrows, informational, no hover.

components.name: Descriptions
components.summary: Key-value record detail: muted terms, neutral values, judgements as chips.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline banner in the four semantic tones; risk messages are always red.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Token-built progress bar: muted track, accent fill, judgement colour only when the bar judges.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: In-page detail dialog, native dialog gives focus trap, Esc, and inert background.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Calm loading placeholder from neutral tokens: static blocks shaped like the content, no shimmer.

components.name: Field & Input
components.summary: Labelled text input, select, and textarea with help and error states.

components.name: Empty state
components.summary: Plain text plus one action: what is empty, when content appears, and the button that fixes it.

components.name: Dropdown
components.summary: Native select with an inset chevron, and a details-based action menu that works with JavaScript off.

components.name: Lead form & CTA row
components.summary: Lead-capture form grid, and the one-row contact CTA.

components.name: Date picker
components.summary: The platform's own date control styled by the kit: calendar popup, locale, and mobile wheels for free.

components.name: Nav
components.summary: Horizontal link bar; the current page carries aria-current.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Numbered progress steps from badge and row primitives, horizontal or vertical, with aria-current.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Facet switcher on native radio inputs with an animated accent underline; works with JavaScript off.

components.name: Product themes
components.summary: Scope classes that re-skin the accent role to a product identity, one accent per view.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Location trail with the kit's glyph separator; the current page is text, not a link.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page controls from ghost buttons with the accent on the current page; compact form for data tables.
